notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter is indestructible.
description:
Deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Frilled Deathspitter trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Frilled Deathspitter instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.
